_doc: STANDARDS-FIRST-1: the commits the system writes itself carry a Conventional Commits 1.0.0 header, `<type>[(scope)][!]: <description>`, where the type is the loop that wrote it. `python3 -m foundation standards --commits` (a probe of the `conventional-commits` row in seed/standards/standards.json, run by `standards --check`) reads every generator under `generators`; a title that does not parse is on `baseline`, which only shrinks (length at most `baseline_ceiling`). A baseline title is one another program or record still matches by its text (foundation/queue.py, scripts/smoke_live.py, docs/PROJECT-MEMORY.md) or whose workflow another change is rewriting; it is changed together with its reader. Read by foundation/commitlint.py; tests tests/foundation/test_commitlint.py.
baseline: .github/workflows/temporal.yml: temporal series, findings and queue items (TEMPORAL-1)
.github/workflows/tenant-repos.yml: Stand alone: vendor the core files $slug reads (TENANT-REPO-1)
